detail.title: GS370SB HiFi Stereo Soundbar Speaker for PC & Laptop
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GS370SB is a compact, USB-powered soundbar delivering a rated 10W of HiFi stereo sound through twin 2-inch drivers, covering a 60Hz-20KHz frequency range for clear vocals and punchy bass alike. Its slim 415mm-wide profile tucks neatly beneath a monitor or laptop display, making it an easy space-saving upgrade over built-in speakers. Rainbow LED lighting effects run across the front for a subtle gaming-desk glow, while a simple volume control wheel keeps loudness adjustments within reach. Connecting is effortless via the 3.5mm AUX input and USB power, working across PCs, laptops, tablets and cellphones alike for movies, music, calls and games.
